Per-group correlation + apex-agreement statistics

Source: R/filtering.R
apex_correlation_statistics.Rd

As correlation_statistics(), plus two columns that compare where the fragment and the precursor elute. Per sample, m1 is the MS1-intensity-weighted mean scan of the precursor trace, m2 the fragment-intensity-weighted mean scan of the group, and the shift is m2 - m1 (in scans):

Usage

apex_correlation_statistics(min_count = 10L)

Arguments

min_count

Groups need more than this many (sample, ms1_scan) cells to be scored.

Value

A statistics closure — see stats-contract.

Details

  • apex_shift_med: median shift across samples.

  • apex_shift_iqr: IQR of the shift across samples.

A real fragment co-elutes with its precursor, so its shift is near 0 in every sample. Conforms to stats-contract; pair with apex_correlation_filtering().

See also

correlation_statistics(), apex_correlation_filtering()
